description: Attribute a total's change to quantity, price, FX, added and removed lines (sums exactly) — Explains why a total moved between two versions of a quote, order or invoice (up to 300 lines each), for an agent that must say how much of the change came from quantity, unit price, exchange rate, new lines and dropped lines. Lines are matched by key. Matched lines are decomposed by sequential substitution in the declared factor order (default quantity, then price, then fx), so the effects sum to

quantity.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

unitPrice.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

quantity.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

unitPrice.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

fx.description: Multiplier from line currency to reporting currency, before and after. Default 1 and 1.

after.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

before.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

order.description: Substitution order of the factors; each at most once. Default [quantity, price, fx].

rounding.description: Default half-even. half-up: ties away from zero. half-down: ties toward zero. half-even: ties to the even neighbour. up: away from zero. down: toward zero. ceiling: toward +infinity. floor: toward -infinity.

statedAfterTotal.description: Optional stated total of `after` to verify.

statedBeforeTotal.description: Optional stated total of `before` (reporting currency) to verify.

name: price-change-attribution
